archetype_description: Jewel & Luxury (Premium, Depth, Mystery) integrated with Gen Z energy. Deep cinematic dark base with electric 'Volt Green' accents to represent live status.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. p-4 to p-8 for containers. Bottom sheet p-6.
layout.border_radius: rounded-3xl for cards and bottom sheets, rounded-full for buttons and markers.
layout.strategy: Minimalist full-screen map with overlapping floating UI. Floating elements must not clutter the map.

map_marker.description: Floating music bubble. A circular avatar with a glowing pulsing border (primary color #D4FF00) if active. Attached is a small glassmorphic pill showing the song name.
map_marker.classes: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2
map_marker.avatar_classes: w-14 h-14 rounded-full border-2 border-[#D4FF00] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,255,0,0.4)] object-cover
map_marker.pill_classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 max-w-[120px] truncate

listen_along_card.description: Appears on clicking a marker. Shows album art, user info, track details, and a massive 'Listen Along' CTA.
listen_along_card.classes: backdrop-blur-3xl bg-black/70 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-6 absolute bottom-32 left-4 right-4 z-40

bottom_sheet.description: Fixed at the bottom of the screen showing the current user's playback status and controls.
bottom_sheet.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full rounded-t-3xl bg-[#12121A] border-t border-white/10 p-6 z-50 flex items-center justify-between

button_primary.description: Used for 'Listen Along' and 'Login with Spotify'. Pill-shaped, high contrast.
button_primary.classes: w-full bg-[#D4FF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,255,0,0.3)] flex justify-center items-center gap-2

spotify_login_screen.description: Full screen dark mode view with abstract dark gradient/blur background.
spotify_login_screen.classes: min-h-screen bg-[#05050A] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 relative overflow-hidden

motion.hover: Scale up (scale-[1.02]) for buttons and interactive cards.
motion.marker_pulse: Continuous subtle scale and opacity pulse for the glowing border around active user markers to signify live playback.
motion.sheet_slide: Slide up from bottom (translate-y-full to translate-y-0) with spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 30).

icons.style: Duotone or bold weight for high visibility on dark backgrounds.

avatars.description: man in white crew neck shirt

album_art.description: Abstract artwork with dynamic warm colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI as an Expo React Native app using NativeWind for Tailwind styling. Avoid Shadcn for raw UI here if NativeWind provides the building blocks, or adapt custom HTML elements closely for web version.
If building for web first, ensure the map takes up 100vh and 100vw (e.g., fixed inset-0), with UI elements floating over it using absolute/fixed positioning and high z-index.
Use Mapbox GL or equivalent with a dark style. The map background should essentially disappear into the deep obsidian #05050A, highlighting only roads and the bright floating markers.
The 'Listen Along' card must use high quality glassmorphism. For web, use backdrop-blur-3xl and bg-black/60 with a thin border-white/10. For Expo native, use Expo BlurView with dark tint.
Use Volt Green (#D4FF00) strictly for active states, 'Listen Along' CTA, and glowing rings around avatars to indicate live playback.
Map Markers should be animated. Use Framer Motion (for web) or Reanimated (for native) to add a subtle floating 'y' axis bobbing effect.
CRITICAL: Include data-testid on ALL interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='login-spotify-button', data-testid='map-marker-user', data-testid='listen-along-cta', data-testid='playback-play-pause'.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts. Ensure Outfit font (or similar expressive Sans) is loaded globally.
